messages:
Evan: Hey all  starting this week and trying to map where docs live. I see multiple "Templates" pages in Notion. Which one is the single source of truth for onboarding/runbooks/templates?
Maya: Welcome Evan! :wave: The short answer: "Central Templates" in Knowledge > Docs is canonical. Teams keep local copies in Team Space for drafts.
Evan: Cool. If I want to create a new onboarding template for a repo, where should I create it first? Team space or Central Templates?
Maya: Start in your Team Space so you can iterate freely. When it's stable and reusable, follow the promotion flow to Central Templates (docs-metadata PR + owner review).
Evan: Who is the owner of Central Templates? I want to ping them.
DocsBot: Auto-suggest: Template steward group = docs-stewards@redwood.internal. Individual owners vary by template; check the property "Owner" at the top of each template page. Use /request-docs-access <page-url> <role> to file requests.
Evan: Is there a minimal front-matter we should include on any template page? I want search and automation to pick it up.
Maya: Yes  add at least: Owner, TemplateVersion, Status(draft|stable|deprecated), Tags, and Short Summary. For runbooks add Severity and RecoverySteps fields. We also recommend a TemplateEligibility flag if you want later promotion.
Evan: What's the easiest way to get edit rights to a canonical template for a tiny fix (typo)?
Sol: If it's just a typo, comment on the template and tag the owner so they can accept the change. If urgent, use the Request Docs Access form and include the page URL + role=editor; owners usually approve quick fixes.
Evan: Are there naming conventions to avoid creating duplicates?
Maya: Use: "Team / Component - DocType - ShortTitle" (e.g., "Infra / Autoscaler - Runbook - Cache Warmup"). Add SearchAliases at the bottom to improve discoverability.
Evan: How do we track templates that change schema so teams who copied them know to migrate?
Maya: TemplateVersion should follow semantic-ish versioning. When a major bump happens, owners add migration notes; docs-metadata PRs must include a CHANGELOG entry and we post to #eng-notices. We also run a weekly report showing pages referencing older TemplateVersions.
Evan: Any tips for embedding code or OpenAPI specs?
Sol: Keep long specs in the repo and link to them; include a small sample snippet in Notion. For diagrams, include a PNG preview and link to the source. Big embeds cause permission and load issues.
Evan: One last Q: who do I ping when SSO blocks link access?
DocsBot: If you get 403, include the Notion URL and your employee ID in the Request Docs Access form or open an IT ticket. IT will check SSO group membership and sync if needed.
Evan: Thanks everyone  filed the access form and will draft in Team Space first. Appreciated!
Maya: Welcome aboard Evan. If you want, we can do a 15m screen-share to show the promotion PR flow and metadata fields. :thumbsup:
